spec.name: The Grande Draz
spec.description: The Great Daraz (al-Daraz al-Kabir) is a historic weaving workshop from the Saadian era located in the Qattanin (cotton workers) neighborhood of Ksar el-Kebir. It was established by the prominent scholar Abu al-Mahasin Yusuf al-Fasi, who endowed its revenues to support religious scholarship at the nearby Great Mosque. The facility once housed numerous looms for traditional woolen textiles and remains a significant witness to the city's industrial and charitable history.

timeline.title: Waqf Endowment
timeline.description: Abu al-Mahasin Yusuf al-Fasi endows the workshop's income to fund chairs of Quranic exegesis (Tafsir) and Hadith.

timeline.title: Restoration
timeline.description: The site is restored through a joint effort between local authorities and the Regional Government of Andalusia.

comments: The site covers approximately 351 square meters and features a traditional central courtyard.
